A.title: Telefonkönyv - PTE
A.text:
TELEFONKÖNYV
Keresés
Keresés a teljes adatbázisban
Szervezeti egységek
Szervezeti egységek listázása
Telephelyek listája
Közérdekű telefonszámok
Személyes menü
Telefonkönyv és e-mail regiszter
Az ötjegyű mellékek a következő központi számokon tárcsázhatók vagy kérhetők:
Oktatási rész: +36 (72) 501-500; ÁOK és Klinikai Központ: +36 (72) 536-000

Egyéb, a fentiektől eltérő központi számok az egyes egységeknél vannak feltüntetve.

PTE dolgozóknak

Tájékoztatjuk kedves egyetemi felhasználóinkat, hogy belépés után saját aktuális elérhetőségeiket szerkeszthetik. A belépéshez kattintson a bal oldali menüben az "eduID Belépés" gombra.

Mobil használat

PTE Telefonkönyv mobilkészüléken is! Ennek az oldalnak a címét helyezze el mobilkészüléke könyvjelzői között. iPhone és egyes Android készülékek a talált telefonszámokat egy kattintással fel is tudják hívni. Megfelelő navigációs szoftver megléte esetén a szervezeti egységek címeire egy kattintással útvonalat is terveztethet!

A keresés módja

A két beviteli mezőben megadhat keresési mintákat, amellyel minden egységben kereshet személyeket.
A megadott minta vonatkozhat egy névtöredékre vagy telefonszámra.
Eredményül a megadott mintának megfelelő személyek listáját kapja.
A névminta a beosztásokban, becenevekben és az E-mail címekben is keres.
A keresési minta beírása után nyomja meg a Keres gombot!

A bal sávban lévő keresés a teljes adatbázisban keres. Ha egy konkrét egységben és alegységeiben szeretne keresni, akkor előbb válassza ki a kívánt szervezeti egységet a szervezeti struktúrából, és az egység adatlapján lévő keresés funkciót használja!

Ingyen hívható intézmények

A Pécsi Tudományegyetem mellékeiről ingyen hívhatók a listában szerepelő telefonszámok.

Karbantartás

A telefonkönyv adatainak karbantartását az egyes szervetei egységeknél ezzel megbízott felelősök bejelentkezés után végezhetik. Ha hibát észlel az adatokban, keresse meg az intézményi megbízottat, vagy írjon a telefonkonyv@pte.hu címre! Ugyanitt igénylehet szerkesztési hozzáférést is.

PÉCSI TUDOMÁNYEGYETEM
H-7622 Pécs, Vasvári Pál utca 4.
Tel.: +36-72/501-500
Email: info@pte.hu

A.text:
Nuestras Bibliotecas 
Recursos Digitales 
Servicios

Participación 
Novedades Bibliográficas

¡Bienvenidos a nuestro espacio de Novedades Bibliográficas! Aquí, la comunidad de la Universidad de Caldas encontrará una selección de nuestras más recientes adquisiciones. Desde textos especializados hasta las últimas publicaciones de interés general, explora un universo de conocimiento que crece y se actualiza constantemente. Sumérgete en las nuevas adiciones a nuestro catálogo, disponibles tanto en formato físico como digital, y enriquece tu experiencia académica y personal con lo más reciente del Centro de Bibliotecas.

Novedades Bibliográficas
Para préstamo físico

Tu opinión es fundamental para enriquecer nuestra colección. Te invitamos a ser parte activa de la construcción de nuestro acervo bibliográfico. Si tienes alguna recomendación de libros, revistas o cualquier material que consideres valioso para la comunidad universitaria, puedes enviarnos tus sugerencias de compra a través de nuestro formulario en línea: Formulario de sugerencias de compra.

Novedades Bibliográficas
Para uso digital

Presentamos las novedades bibliográficas digitales adquiridas por el Centro de Bibliotecas a través de la plataforma Ebsco. Recuerde que debe acceder por medio de su correo electrónico institucional Gmail: @ucaldas.edu.co u Outlook: @udecaldas.edu.co. A los egresados les recordamos que, si no lo han hecho, deben registrarse en la opción Acceso a egresados en el menú de servicios de esta web.

Descubra todos nuestros libros digitales en el siguiente enlace

A.title: 美國菩提學會 ─ 性空長老 網路講座
A.text:
美國菩提學會 甘露法雨
性空長老 網路講座
初期瑜伽行派之止觀要義 ─ 《解深密經》〈分別瑜伽品〉 之四
2022年7月22日、7月29日、8月6日、8月12日、8月15日

2022年年初美國菩提學會極其榮幸邀請到性空長老開示《解深密經》〈分別瑜伽品〉。由於〈分別瑜伽品〉篇幅較長，長老將分時段講授本品。 此次性空長老將為我們繼續開示上次未講完的部分。 有興趣聞法者請按下面連結溫習本課程過去的視頻：性空長老《解深密經》〈分別瑜伽品〉YouTube Playlist。

在佛法的修學中，《解深密經》(Saṃdhinirmocana-sūtra)是初期唯識學瑜伽行派的要典。本經的禪觀學理，從頭到尾緊扣佛陀的“十二分教”，作為修習止觀的基礎， 完全符應《雜阿含經》中定慧綜合的禪觀教學，也是“七覺分”的完滿開展。

《解深密經》〈分別瑜伽品〉對於修行至為重要，它說明由凡夫而至佛位的勝行，這是依大乘瑜伽師的禪觀慧悟，而流傳出來的教法。學習〈分別瑜伽品〉可以瞭解初期瑜伽行派的修行內容與特色。在本品中，慈氏(彌勒)菩薩向佛陀請教修習止觀的內容，佛陀於是開示了完整的禪觀定義、範疇、類別、內涵與技巧。《分別瑜伽品》共有十八門，說明修瑜伽行中止觀的義相，顯示唯識止觀的妙行。

性空長老（Ven. Dhammadipa） ，捷克人，1949年出生於布拉格，是一位學行兼備的禪修老師和精研南北傳經論的佛教學者。1987年，長老於斯里蘭卡剃度出家，1989年於洛杉磯西來寺受三壇大戒。法師亦深具語言天份，除了母語捷克文之外，還精通梵文及巴利文，並且廣通法、德、英、中、俄、印度、日語等十幾種語言，聽、讀、說、寫，溝通無礙。

長老曾於台灣福嚴佛學院、佛光山、中華佛研所擔任客座講師，並於世界各地弘法；包括歐美、台灣、中國、印度及東南亞各國的漢傳、南傳、藏傳寺院和大學。此外，長老也致力於寫作和翻譯佛教經論。

近年來，除了在長老致力世界各地弘法外，於印度的Jetavan Sakarwadi project，幫助Sakarwadi 佛教社區提升教育、醫療及整體生活水準，又成立並主持法島基金會（Dhammadipa Foundation），在捷克建立寂靜林（Shanta Vana），以弘揚禪法，提供禪修者一個良好的修行環境。

性空長老有一種慈悲、溫和、清新的人格特質。他的教學，在戒定慧的三增上學中，為學員們專注的訓練和智慧的發展奠定了豐厚的基礎。長老教導我們應該在生活中實踐佛法，並發心要為所有眾生的利益修行，透過自己的經驗親證佛法。性空長老是當代佛教中罕見的寶石。

開示：初期瑜伽行派之止觀要義 ─ 《解深密經》〈分別瑜伽品〉之四
日期： 美西時間 2022年7月22日 (週五)、7月29日 (週五)、8月6日 (週六)、8月12日 (週五)、8月15日 (週一)
時間： 美西時間 9:30 ~ 11:00 AM
語言：以華語開示
方式：Zoom meeting，講座免費，歡迎邀請親朋好友參加。

iZUŠ
O škole

Základní umělecká škola v Rumburku je příspěvkovou organizací Ústeckého kraje. Hlavní náplní činnosti je poskytování základů uměleckého vzdělání v hudebním a výtvarném oboru. Působí v Rumburku (budova v ul. Růžová a budova v ul. F.Nohy) a další pobočky má ve Šluknově, Jiříkově, Dolní Poustevně, Vilémově, Mikulášovicích, Krásné Lípě a ve Velkém Šenově.

Hawaiʻi Children's Theatre
Home
EXPLORE
PROGRAMS
Shop
Donate & Membership
Tickets

HAWAIʻI CHILDREN'S THEATRE

A stage for every star

From first bows to full-scale Broadway musicals — there’s a place for every performer in HCT’s ʻohana.

Hawaiʻi Children’s Theatre provides performing arts opportunities for children, teens, and adults on Kauaʻi through classes, camps, workshops, and full theatrical productions. Whatever your age or experience level, there’s a program here to help you learn, create, and perform.

Summer Stars

AGES 5–15 · JUNE–JULY · REGISTRATION BASED

HCT’s flagship summer program gives young performers the opportunity to build skills in acting, singing, dancing, creativity, and theatre production.

Explore Summer Stars
HCT Academy

YOUTH · YEAR-ROUND · REGISTRATION BASED

HCT Academy gives students opportunities throughout the year to explore acting, musical theatre, movement, improvisation, performance skills, and other areas of the performing arts.

Explore HCT Academy
Mainstage

YOUTH & ADULTS · AUGUST–NOVEMBER · AUDITION BASED

HCT’s Mainstage production brings together young performers, adults, and professional theatre artists for a large-scale Broadway-style musical presented each fall.

Explore Mainstage
After Dark

AGES 15+ · PRIMARILY SUMMER · AUDITION BASED

HCT After Dark gives older teens, alumni, adults, and experienced performers the opportunity to explore more challenging material, complex characters, and advanced theatrical work.

Explore After Dark

The curtain rises when you walk in.

NEWSLETTER

Stay in the spotlight

Show announcements, audition notices, and class & Summer Stars registration openings — straight to your inbox.

Read past newsletters →

Hawaiʻi Children's Theatre

Inspiring community through the study, performance and appreciation of the theater arts — serving Kauaʻi since 1996.

A.title: S’abonner à L'Atelier Paysan
A.text:
L'Atelier Paysan

Formations autoconstruction d'outils de travail agricole. Plateforme web du matériel libre et de l'autoconstruction en agriculture.

Qu’est-ce qu’un flux RSS ?

Un fil RSS recueille les informations de mise à jour d’un site. Il fournit le contenu des billets ou des commentaires ou un extrait de ceux-ci, ainsi qu’un lien vers les versions complètes et quelques autres informations. Ce fil a pour vocation d’être lu par un agrégateur RSS.

S’abonner

Copiez l’URL suivante dans votre agrégateur : 

"Nos quartiers en campagne" : tour des France pour des alliances entre les villes et les campagnes !

Trop souvent, le débat public oppose les territoires ruraux et les quartiers populaires. Ces deux mondes partagent bien plus qu'on ne veut le faire croire : des habitant•es qui s'organisent, des territoires qui résistent, des initiatives locales, des luttes pour l'accès aux services publics, l'autonomie, la justice sociale et le pouvoir d'agir.
L'Atelier Paysan se joint à la Coordination Pas sans Nous, à la Confédération Paysanne, au réseau CIVAM et à la Fédération de l'Audiovisuel (…)

- Actualités
Portes-ouvertes en Isère : le 5 novembre 2026 !

Cette année on remet le couvert à Renage, et nous ouvrons nos portes du site principal de l'Atelier Paysan pour vous faire découvrir le cœur de nos activités et échanger en direct avec l'équipe !
Le 5 novembre à de 9h30 à 17h
Réservez votre journée, votre demi-journée ou quelques heures pour se rencontrer, et partager un repas sur le pouce le midi.
Au menu
• Un espace forum : venez discuter avec les personnes impliquées dans l'organisation des formations à l'autoconstruction, dans (…)

- Actualités
Financement des formations : fonds de soutien exceptionnel pour faire face aux insuffisances de Vivéa

Vivéa, Vivéa pas ...?
Depuis octobre 2025, les accords de financement Vivéa sont très aléatoires. Pour Vivéa, l'autonomie technique n'est pas une priorité [1].
Bonne nouvelle : nos formations d'octobre sont assurées d'être financées pour les cotisant·es Vivéa. Nous espérons qu'il en sera de même pour les suivantes.
Les actions qui sont assurées de financement Vivéa sont indiquées dans la programmation grâce à ce visuel : Les autres formations programmées ne sont pas encore passées en (…)

- Actualités
Lecteurs et lectrices de "Terre Dauphinoise" : nos formations vous sont ouvertes !

Cette semaine, nous avons voulu acheter un encart dans l'hebdomadaire agricole Terre Dauphinoise pour annoncer nos prochaines formations aux agriculteurs et agricultrices de l'Isère. Une démarche banale, payée au prix normal.
Cette demande a été refusée au motif "d'un arbitrage interne lié à la ligne du titre et à son lectorat". Traduisons : L'annonce n'avait rien de choquante elle proposait d'apprendre à souder des outils agricoles... mais elle venait de nous.
Depuis bientôt vingt ans, (…)

- Actualités
Désarmer l'industrie des pesticides : mêmes colères, mêmes combats !

Samedi 3 octobre à Saint-Pierre-la-Garenne (Eure)

Blog Awesome News and information from Font Awesome – the internet’s favorite icon set; mixed with musings and nerdery from the team behind it. 2026-10-08T14:13:54Z https://blog.fontawesome.com/ Font Awesome Add Kits, Pageviews, and More Without Upgrading Your Plan 2026-10-08T14:13:54Z https://blog.fontawesome.com/add-without-upgrading/

“But I was going into Tosche Station to pick up some power converters!”

Until now, outgrowing one part of your Font Awesome plan meant upgrading the whole thing. If you ran out of Kits while your pageviews and bandwidth were fine as-is, the only fix was moving up a tier and paying for a pile of extras you’d never use.

That never felt right to us. If you love Solo and just need a few more Kits, you should be able to get a few more Kits.

Now you can. 

(There’s no Uncle Owen blocking you now. You get those power converters, kid.) 

Meet plan add-ons

Paid plans can now add extra capacity exactly where you need it, and nowhere else:

  • Kits: 5 Kits for $10
  • Custom Icons: 100 Custom Icons for $5
  • Pageviews: 250K pageviews/mo for $18/yr
  • Bandwidth: 1 GB/mo for $9/yr

Pick what you need from one screen and see your total before you confirm. Add-ons renew with your subscription, so there’s nothing extra to track.

Cheaper than overages, on purpose

Overage billing is still there as a safety net if your traffic spikes unexpectedly. But if you already know you’ll need more pageviews or bandwidth, an add-on costs about 25% less than paying overages for the same usage. Unpredictable spikes can fall back on overages. A.title: Telefonkönyv - PTE
A.text:
TELEFONKÖNYV
Keresés
Keresés a teljes adatbázisban
Telefonkönyv és e-mail regiszter
Az ötjegyű mellékek a következő központi számokon tárcsázhatók vagy kérhetők:
Oktatási rész: +36 (72) 501-500; ÁOK és Klinikai Központ: +36 (72) 536-000

Egyéb, a fentiektől eltérő központi számok az egyes egységeknél vannak feltüntetve.

PTE dolgozóknak

Tájékoztatjuk kedves egyetemi felhasználóinkat, hogy belépés után saját aktuális elérhetőségeiket szerkeszthetik. A belépéshez kattintson a bal oldali menüben az "eduID Belépés" gombra.

Mobil használat

PTE Telefonkönyv mobilkészüléken is! Ennek az oldalnak a címét helyezze el mobilkészüléke könyvjelzői között. iPhone és egyes Android készülékek a talált telefonszámokat egy kattintással fel is tudják hívni. Megfelelő navigációs szoftver megléte esetén a szervezeti egységek címeire egy kattintással útvonalat is terveztethet!

A keresés módja

A két beviteli mezőben megadhat keresési mintákat, amellyel minden egységben kereshet személyeket.
A megadott minta vonatkozhat egy névtöredékre vagy telefonszámra.
Eredményül a megadott mintának megfelelő személyek listáját kapja.
A névminta a beosztásokban, becenevekben és az E-mail címekben is keres.
A keresési minta beírása után nyomja meg a Keres gombot!

A bal sávban lévő keresés a teljes adatbázisban keres. Ha egy konkrét egységben és alegységeiben szeretne keresni, akkor előbb válassza ki a kívánt szervezeti egységet a szervezeti struktúrából, és az egység adatlapján lévő keresés funkciót használja!

Ingyen hívható intézmények

A Pécsi Tudományegyetem mellékeiről ingyen hívhatók a listában szerepelő telefonszámok.

Karbantartás

A telefonkönyv adatainak karbantartását az egyes szervetei egységeknél ezzel megbízott felelősök bejelentkezés után végezhetik. Ha hibát észlel az adatokban, keresse meg az intézményi megbízottat, vagy írjon a telefonkonyv@pte.hu címre! Ugyanitt igénylehet szerkesztési hozzáférést is.

PÉCSI TUDOMÁNYEGYETEM
H-7622 Pécs, Vasvári Pál utca 4.
Tel.: +36-72/501-500
Email: info@pte.hu

Bobiko.Blog Blog nie tylko technologiczny (Ostatnie 25 wpisów) https://bobiko.blog/ pl-PL https://bobiko.blog/favicon.png Bobiko ▪ Blog https://bobiko.blog 32 32 Astro RSS Feed (Generated: 2026-10-12T14:45:46.475Z) Sztuka mądrego odpuszczania https://bobiko.blog/2026/09/sztuka-madrego-odpuszczania https://bobiko.blog/2026/09/sztuka-madrego-odpuszczania Refleksja przed czterdziestką o tym, kiedy warto skasować tysiąc znaków przed wciśnięciem 'Opublikuj', a gdzie leży nienaruszalna granica milczenia. Tue, 15 Sep 2026 14:02:22 GMT

Stojąc tuż przed progiem czterdziestych urodzin, zaczynam nieco inaczej patrzeć na własne zasoby — czasowe i emocjonalne. Ostatnio złapałem się na specyficznym nawyku, który powtarza się regularnie od dłuższego czasu. Przeglądam sieć — Facebooka, fora, Reddita, lokalne grupy dyskusyjne — i trafiam na wątek, który wywołuje potrzebę reakcji.

1000 znaków w próżnię, czyli przycisk Anuluj

Otwieram okno odpowiedzi. Zaczynam pisać. W zależności od tematu piszę albo emocjonalnie, albo chłodno i “po profesorsku”, starając się rzetelnie coś wyjaśnić lub polemizować z autorem. Potrafię wlać w to pole kilkaset, a czasem i ponad tysiąc znaków przemyślanego tekstu.

I co robię chwilę później?

Zamiast kliknąć Opublikuj, zastanawiam się kilka sekund. Potem zaznaczam całość, wciskam kasowanie, zamykam kartę i idę robić swoje.

Dlaczego? Bo w głowie pojawia się chłodna kalkulacja: Co ten mój komentarz tak naprawdę zmieni? Czy wniesie cokolwiek wartościowego do mojego życia albo realnie wpłynie na czyjeś postrzeganie świata? Odpowiedź niemal zawsze brzmi: nic. Po co więc marnować energię, niepotrzebnie się unosić i obnażać w internetowych przepychankach?

Odpowiedzialność pod własnym imieniem i nazwiskiem

W przeciwieństwie do szerokiej rzeszy anonimowych komentatorów, hejterów czy internetowych stalkerów, w sieci zawsze występuję pod własnym imieniem i nazwiskiem. Jeśli coś publikuję, biorę za to pełną odpowiedzialność — moje opinie są przemyślane i podpisuję się pod nimi bez mrużenia oka. I może właśnie ta odpowiedzialność sprawia, że poprzeczka zawieszona przed kliknięciem “Wyślij” jest u mnie tak wysok

阳阳有点不知道应该往那些方向运营咖啡厅了呢…. 所以，想在这里询问大家有没有一些对咖啡厅，或者对论坛的意见！！
关于咖啡厅的初心…..是想要和大家共同创建一个可以让大家交朋友，一个可以给大家带来温暖的小窝…

当然！ 想要实现这些的前提，是想要和大家一起努力呢，毕竟…咖啡厅是属于大家的哦，咖啡厅的环境也是由大家决定的……所以，尽情的发表自己的意见吧！！！不管是很棒的意见，很不好的意见，尽情的在这里发表吧！！

诶？你问店长有没有理想？嗯…理想的话….当然是想要在现实中开一家能和大家一起玩耍的咖啡厅啦~~
如果…这个目标实现的话，阳阳要送咖啡厅的大家一人一杯免费的咖啡~ ~ ！ ˃̶͈ ꇴ ˂̶͈
所以…你对咖啡厅目前的状态，有什么可以改进的好想法吗~ ？

A.text:
HOME
 
RESTAURANT
 
BEER
 
MENUS
 
GEM BAR
 
LIVE MUSIC & EVENTS
 
SHOP
BOOJUM BREWING
WAYNESVILLE, NC
Located in the shadow of the Smoky Mountains, our Downtown Waynesville taproom has a relaxed atmosphere where you can enjoy lunch, dinner or drinks.  

Enjoy seasonal pub faire including tasty burgers, sandwiches, seafood & steak. Our taproom features 16 taps of fresh, delicious & ever rotating Boojum Beer plus wine & craft cocktails. Come cozy up inside or take in the mountain air on our back deck. At night, check out our 21+ speakeasy-style Gem Bar, located just below the restaurant. 

WHAT'S THE WAIT RIGHT NOW?
PHONE

Restaurant - (828) 246-0350

Brewery - (828) 944-0888 

LOCATION

50 N Main St.
Waynesville, Nc 28786

 

HOURS

M, W-Sun 11.30am–9pm

Tues Closed           

                         
CURRENT LINEUP

HOP FIEND IPA  Hops, hops, hops. Nothing else matters to a hop fiend. They gather them up, admire them, hoard them, love them, devour them - always thirsting for more.
A West Coast IPA generously hopped with Mosaic, Simcoe & Citra, Hop Fiend is the perfect blend of tropical fruit, citrus & pine.
See hops. Want hops. Drink hops. 6.5%

REWARD PALE ALE  Crisp, hop forward & dangerously drinkable. This dry-hopped pale ale opens with a citrusy aroma and finishes nice & clean. 5.6%

HOUNDS OF HELLES LAGER  You’ve sniffed out our light & refreshing Munich-style Helles. This golden lager is prized for its soft, bready malt character, easy drinkability & crisp finish. It’s just what you’ve been looking for. 5% ABV

BLUE RIDGE HAZE IPA  Rolling in fresh, juicy & tropical, this hazy IPA is packed with the finest blend of El Dorado, Equinox, Huell Melon, Mosaic & Idaho 7 hops. Enter a cloud of pine & citrus & immerse yourself in flavors of mango, pineapple, strawberry & papaya 6.2% ABV

KING OF THE MOUNTAIN DIPA  From the highest cave in the range, the Boojum watches over his domain. Others fall in line behind the biggest beast, the most dangerous creature. In his honor, we created a beast of a beer, able to stand up to all others. Double the hops. Double the malt. We didn’t hold back on the beer destined to be king. 8%

CHUPACABRA MEXICAN LAGER  Crisp, clean & refreshing with mild malt & noble hop flavors. German malts & flaked corn provide a light body for this smooth lager. 4.5% ABV

NEW YEAR ROUND RELEASE

Light, smooth & citrusy, this White Ale is crafted with white wheat, CuraCao oranges & freshly ground coriander. Subtle spice notes & bright citrus create a unique & refreshing flavor, while wheat & oats provide a soft feel & crisp finish. So hurry up, take a sip & follow the White Rabbit on a curiously tasty trip. 5% ABV 

AVAILABLE ON DRAFT & IN CANS NOW.

ROTATING RELEASES

SPECIAL RELEASE SERIES

Lush & green summertime IPA with strawberry, melon, citrus & passionfruit hop flavors.  6% ABV  MARCH - JULY

HAZY IPA SERIES

GET OFF MY CLOUD NE IPA  Juicy, hazy New England IPA brewed with heaps of El Dorado, Huell Melon, Mosaic, Citra, E

A.title: Instrução Normativa PRES/INSS nº 213
A.text:
Instrução Normativa PRES/INSS nº 213, de 17.08.2026
- DOU de 19.08.2026 -

Altera a Instrução Normativa PRES/INSS nº 138, de 10 de novembro 2022, que estabelece critérios e procedimentos operacionais relativos à consignação de descontos para pagamento de crédito consignado contraído nos benefícios pagos pelo INSS.

A PRESIDENTE DO INSTITUTO NACIONAL DO SEGURO SOCIAL - INSS, no uso das atribuições que lhe confere o Decreto nº 10.995, de 14 de março de 2022, e tendo em vista o que consta no Processo Administrativo nº 35014.065975/2022-22, resolve:

Art. 1ºA Instrução Normativa PRES/INSS nº 138, de 10 de novembro de 2022, republicada no Diário Oficial da União de 13 de dezembro de 2022, passa a vigorar com as seguintes alterações:

"Art. 5º.............................................................................

.........................................................................................

§ 20. A autorização de que trata o inciso IX, do caput, se dará via termo de autorização de portabilidade para as operações de portabilidade, devendo a instituição consignatária proponente confirmar a operação em até vinte dias contados da autorização do titular do benefício, sob pena de cancelamento da operação.

§ 21. A autorização da operação no aplicativo Meu INSS será oportunizada mediante login gov.br e utilização dos dados da conta bancária quando não existir a biometria nas bases governamentais para fins de validação da imagem de que trata o inciso IX, do caput." (NR)

"Art. 8º.............................................................................

.........................................................................................

§ 1º Os benefícios referidos no art. 1º, concedidos a partir de 1º de abril de 2019, permanecerão bloqueados para a realização de crédito consignado por noventa dias, contados da Data de Despacho do Benefício - DDB, ou seja, da data de concessão do benefício.

........................................................................................." (NR)

"Art. 23-A. Os descontos e respectivos repasses serão interrompidos em razão do não envio de documentos ou informações exigidas nesta Instrução Normativa pelas instituições consignatárias." (NR)

"Art. 34...............................................................................

...........................................................................................

VI - ......................................................................................

............................................................................................

f) dados estruturados referentes ao depósito dos valores correspondentes às operações de crédito consignado em até sete dias úteis da contratação;

..........................................................................................." (NR)

"Art. 36.............................................................................

................................................................

Guide complet pour votre première saison

Vous êtes responsable d’une organisation sportive et avez choisi Retroaction pour vous simplifier la vie ? Ce guide est fait pour vous ! Son objectif est de vous donner un aperçu clair de ce à quoi peut ressembler la gestion de votre organisation avec Retroaction, tout en vous accompagnant étape par étape pour y parvenir. Ce guide est particulièrement adapté aux sports d’équipe comme le hockey, le soccer, le baseball, ou tout autre domaine similaire.

Il est recommandé de lire la publication Liste des termes essentiels pour connaître la définition des termes importants.

Étapes
Créer la saison

A.title: Journey Desktop 2024: Sneak Peek of New Desktop App for Windows, Mac & Linux - Journey Forum
A.text:
Sign UpLog In
DesktopAnnouncement
Journey Desktop 2024: Sneak Peek of New Desktop App for Windows, Mac & Linux
Log In to Reply
 Original Post
1 of 44 posts
July 2024
0 UNREAD
 Now
admin
Jul 14, 2024

Dear Journey patron,

We heard you. We understand you need a better desktop app for Journey, and we are excited to share our plans for its future.

The current Windows, Mac Classic, and Linux apps are in maintenance mode due to outdated technology that makes it unsustainable to continue their development. These older versions also lack important features that many of you have requested, such as Apple sign-in and Journey Cloud Sync. To address these limitations and provide a more seamless, modern experience, we are introducing a new desktop app: "Journey Desktop 2024." This new app will replace the existing Windows, Mac Classic, and Linux apps to offer improved functionality and a better overall user experience.

What to Expect:

Journey Desktop 2024 is designed to meet the evolving needs of our users and will come with a host of exciting new features:

A new colored theme UI
Journey Cloud Sync
Email and Apple login
End-to-End Encryption (E2EE)
Shared web links and journals
Print to PDF
Export to DOCX and EPUB formats
Odyssey AI
Smart photo organization
Elastic search
Support self-host

We are committed to delivering a superior journaling experience with Journey Desktop 2024. We plan to release the alpha version by early August 2024, and we can't wait for you to try it out and share your feedback.

Thank you for your continued support and trust in Journey.

Warm regards,
The Journey Team

 Original Post

0 UNREAD
 Now
giuliomoro
Apr 29, 2020Edited

We are excited to announce that we just released a course on C++ Real-Time Audio Programming with Bela. This is aimed at beginner to intermediate C++ users, so if you have so far been using Bela with other languages and you are interested in tipping you toes in C++, this is a great occasion. If you know your C++ stuff, you may still want to check out some of the more advanced topics (ARM/NEON assembly, state machines, fixed-point maths, timing, block-based processing).

During the course you will learn:

Writing real-time audio code in C++
Running that code on embedded hardware
Creating musical instruments, audio effects and synth modules
Turning digital signal processing theory into working code

New lessons will be coming out twice a week for a few months, covering programming topics such as:

Working in real time, Buffers and arrays, Parameter control, Classes and objects, Analog and digital I/O, Filtering, Circular buffers, Timing in real time, State machines, MIDI, Block-based processing, Threads, Fixed point arithmetic, ARM assembly language

all of this while building audio signal processors that implement:

Oscillators, Samples, Wavetables, Filters, Control voltages, Gates and triggers, Delays and delay-based effects, Metronomes and clocks, Envelopes, ADSR, MIDI, Additive synthesis, Phase vocoders, Impulse reverb

Subscribe to our youtube channel so that you don't miss any of the upcoming classes, and feel free to share this with your friends on Twitter, Facebook and Instagram.

Af a "getting started" lesson 0 last week, the course has fully started today with lesson 1, and the next class will be out this Friday at 5pm.

Note: you will need up-to-date Bela code to follow along with the course, as the example code relies on some of the latest features we added (namely the slider Gui via the GuiController library). Updating your board is covered in lesson 0.

As you'd expect, you can find support here on the forum, using the "Online C++ course" tag.

nicklear Oh spellcast_win.exe now also considered a malware?
To clarify:

spell_win is responsible for detecting shortcut press. It is essential for calling up search bar and executing any command that has shortcut assigned.
spellcast_win is responsible for simulating shortcut press. This one needed for "Keyboard Shortcut", "Apply Transition", "Timecode" commands.

They are perfectly safe.

A.title: Mănăstirea “Sfânta Treime” (Saharna) - Resurse Educaționale
A.text:
Resurse Educaționale
ÎnregistrareConectare
 Recreere / Excursii
Mănăstirea “Sfânta Treime” (Saharna)
Răspunde
 Postarea originală
1 din 16 postări
mai 2021
0 NECITITE
 Acum
luna
13 mai 2021Modificat

Mănăstirea Saharna, în întregul ei ansamblu, este unul din cele mai vechi aşezăminte monahale din cuprinsul Bisericii Ortodoxe din Republica Moldova. Ansamblul monastic este compus din două mănăstiri: una rupestră (Bunavestire) şi alta terestră (Sf. Treime).

Istoria mănăstirii rupestre se cunoaşte foarte puţin, neştiindu-se data precisă a întemeierii şi cine sunt întemeietorii. Nici chiar cercetătorii din domeniu n-au ajuns încă la o părere unanimă privind perioada întemeierii acestei chinovii. Ea rămâne blândă şi tăcută în aşteptarea unor timpuri mai bune, când istoria ei zbuciumată, dar şi glorioasă, va fi cunoscută şi elogiată de toată lumea creştină.

Mănăstirea terestră, fiind o ctitorie călugărească, a fost întemeiată în anul 1776 de către Schimonahul Vartolomeu Ciungu (anii de viaţă – 1739-1798, Ciungu nu este numele de familie, ci doar un apelativ). Câte ceva despre viaţa stareţului Vartolomeu aflăm din inscripţia, ce însoţea portretul lui, descoperit în trapeza mănăstirii „Sf. Treime” Rudi de către inginerul-arhitect Nicolae Ţiganco, portret, ce mai târziu dispare fără urmă. Iată această inscripţie, tradusă din limba ucraineană în română în anul 1928: „… în 1739 în ziua 23 a lunii decembrie a avut loc naşterea trupească, /a/ numitu/lui/ Vasile, /din/părintele preot Teodor şi maică Pelagheia. În anul 1760 în ziua de 2 a lunii mai în oraşul Savran gubernia Podoliei, fiind logodit şi mergând la logodnica sa pentru a se căsători, Vasile fusese pe neaşteptate rănit cu un glonţ în mâna stângă, iar la an 1766 … a lunii mai a părăsit patria sa şi a venit în Moldova. An 1776 în luna martie ziua 25 a intrat în Saharna. Nu era nimic, era acolo un loc pustiu, a clădit biserica, chilii, ogradă şi altele”.

Există unele momente, care ne permit să presupunem că până a începe construcţia noii mănăstiri, Vartolomeu cu o mică comunitate de călugări trăiseră în mănăstirea din stâncă. Însă viaţa în acel loc era foarte anevoioasă şi părintele Vartolomeu hotărăşte construcţia unei mănăstiri terestre, care ar fi fost şi aproape de căile de comunicare din localităţile apropiate, şi aşezată într-un loc unde liniştea călugărilor nu avea să fie tulburată prea mult de forfota lumească. Era destul de dificil să găseşti un asemenea loc şi după cum spune tradiţia că se cuvenea unui bun călugăr şi creştin, înainte de începerea lucrărilor, Vartolomeu trăieşte 40 de zile de post şi rugăciune, pentru a milostivi pe Dumnezeu şi sfinţii, ca să fie ajutat în alegerea cât mai reuşită a unui loc pentru construcţia mănăstirii. Legenda spune, că la a 40-ea zi de rugăciune, el a avut o revelaţie. I s-a arătat Preasfânta Fecioară Maria, Născătoarea de Dumnezeu, care era înconjurată de foc ceresc şi i-a arătat locul, unde, după voia Celui Preaînalt, trebuia să construiască locaşul mon

Nici chiar cercetătorii din domeniu n-au ajuns încă la o părere unanimă privind perioada întemeierii acestei chinovii. Ea rămâne blândă şi tăcută în aşteptarea unor timpuri mai bune, când istoria ei zbuciumată, dar şi glorioasă, va fi cunoscută şi elogiată de toată lumea creştină.

Mănăstirea terestră, fiind o ctitorie călugărească, a fost întemeiată în anul 1776 de către Schimonahul Vartolomeu Ciungu (anii de viaţă – 1739-1798, Ciungu nu este numele de familie, ci doar un apelativ). Câte ceva despre viaţa stareţului Vartolomeu aflăm din inscripţia, ce însoţea portretul lui, descoperit în trapeza mănăstirii „Sf. Treime” Rudi de către inginerul-arhitect Nicolae Ţiganco, portret, ce mai târziu dispare fără urmă. Iată această inscripţie, tradusă din limba ucraineană în română în anul 1928: „… în 1739 în ziua 23 a lunii decembrie a avut loc naşterea trupească, /a/ numitu/lui/ Vasile, /din/părintele preot Teodor şi maică Pelagheia. În anul 1760 în ziua de 2 a lunii mai în oraşul Savran gubernia Podoliei, fiind logodit şi mergând la logodnica sa pentru a se căsători, Vasile fusese pe neaşteptate rănit cu un glonţ în mâna stângă, iar la an 1766 … a lunii mai a părăsit patria sa şi a venit în Moldova. An 1776 în luna martie ziua 25 a intrat în Saharna. Nu era nimic, era acolo un loc pustiu, a clădit biserica, chilii, ogradă şi altele”.

Există unele momente, care ne permit să presupunem că până a începe construcţia noii mănăstiri, Vartolomeu cu o mică comunitate de călugări trăiseră în mănăstirea din stâncă. Însă viaţa în acel loc era foarte anevoioasă şi părintele Vartolomeu hotărăşte construcţia unei mănăstiri terestre, care ar fi fost şi aproape de căile de comunicare din localităţile apropiate, şi aşezată într-un loc unde liniştea călugărilor nu avea să fie tulburată prea mult de forfota lumească. Era destul de dificil să găseşti un asemenea loc şi după cum spune tradiţia că se cuvenea unui bun călugăr şi creştin, înainte de începerea lucrărilor, Vartolomeu trăieşte 40 de zile de post şi rugăciune, pentru a milostivi pe Dumnezeu şi sfinţii, ca să fie ajutat în alegerea cât mai reuşită a unui loc pentru construcţia mănăstirii. Legenda spune, că la a 40-ea zi de rugăciune, el a avut o revelaţie. I s-a arătat Preasfânta Fecioară Maria, Născătoarea de Dumnezeu, care era înconjurată de foc ceresc şi i-a arătat locul, unde, după voia Celui Preaînalt, trebuia să construiască locaşul mon

Bor Eksikliği:

Problem: Cannabis yaprakları ve köklerinde anormallik büyümede yavaşlama. Bor Eksikliğinin ilk belirtilerinden biri anormal veya kalınlaşmış yaprak uçlarıdır.. Yeni yapraklarda sarılaşma görülebilir. Dal gövdeleri kaba ama koflaşabilir. Çiçek sanki Kalsiyum eksikliği çekiyormuş gibi görünebilir. Çünkü, bitkinin Kalsiyumu etkin kullanabilmesi için Bora ihtiyaç duyulur. Yeni büyüyen bitkiler en çok ekilenenlerdir. Bitkiniz sanki yanmış veya alazlanmış gibi görünebilir . Eğer toprataki Ph değeri çok yüksekse (kullandığınız su veya fazla gübrelemeden dolayı yükseltmiş olabilirsiniz) de Bor Eksikliği belirtilerini gösterebilir çiçeğiniz. Bakınız aşağıdaki resim örnekleri;



Çözüm: Temiz, kaliteli su, ile bitkinizi flushlayın (yıkayın toprağını) Ph değeri ayarlı (ya da olması gereken normal değerde kaliteli) suya normal dozun yarısı kadar besin katın ve çiçeğinizin yeni gelişen dal ve yapraklarının sağlığını gözlemleyin.

Kalsiyum Eksikliği:

Problem: Kalsiyum eksikliğini farketmek nispeten zor bir iştir. Zira sıklıkla, magnezyum, demir ve diğer eksikliklerin semptomları ile karıştırılabiliyor. Yinede, kalsiyum eksikliğinin bazı genel belirtileri şunlardır: Yapraklarda ölü bölgeler noktalar oluşur, ufak kahverengi noktalar, bölgeler gibi. Diğer önemli bir belirtiside, yeni gelen yaprakların ufak olması ve uclarının biçimsizleşmesi kıvrılmasıdır. Bitkinin içinde veya çiçeklerde/sömeklerde zayıflama görülebilir. Köklerde bakteri izleri, ölü veya yetersiz gelişme görülebilir.Detaylı fikir edinmek için bakınız aşağıdaki resimler:


Çözüm: Eğer çiçeğinizin kök bölgesindeki pH bozuksa, kötü ise bu demektir ki, cannabisiniz kalsiyumu uygun şekilde abzorbe edemiyordur. İlk adım, yetişme bölgesindeki doğru pH değerlerine sahip olduğunuzdan emin olun. Her cannabis çeşidi kendine özgü besin problemlerine sahiptir. Ancak, kalsiyum, magnezyum ve demir problemleri çoğunlukla aynı zamanda ortaya çıkar cannabiste.
Pro yetiştiriciler, gübre tedarik ederken ayrıca CaMg (Kalsiyum Magnezyum) sağlayan tamamlayıcı besinide verirler. Bu sayede bu tarz eksikliklerin önüne geçerler. Eğer şimdiye kadar elinizde böyle bir tamamlayıcı yoksa, hemen tedarik ederek bitkinize verdiğinizde bir hafta içerisinde sağlıklı büyümeyi gözlemlersiniz.

Bakır Eksikligi:

Problem: Cannabiste bakır eksikliği, yaprakların geriye doğru kıvrılması, büyüme eksikliği ve yapraklarda anormal renk değişikliği şeklinde tezahür eder. Diğer yapraklarda sarı veya beyazlama işaretleri belirirken, yeni gelen yapraklar koyu ve dönmüş olarak gelişebilir.Toprağınızda veya suyunuzda bakır bulunması pek olası değil. Bakır eksikliği genellikle pH problem yaşandığı zaman ortaya çıkar. Yani pH bozulduğunda çiçeğiniz bakırı orda olsa bile çekemez. Detaylı

İlk adım, yetişme bölgesindeki doğru pH değerlerine sahip olduğunuzdan emin olun. Her cannabis çeşidi kendine özgü besin problemlerine sahiptir. Ancak, kalsiyum, magnezyum ve demir problemleri çoğunlukla aynı zamanda ortaya çıkar cannabiste.
Pro yetiştiriciler, gübre tedarik ederken ayrıca CaMg (Kalsiyum Magnezyum) sağlayan tamamlayıcı besinide verirler. Bu sayede bu tarz eksikliklerin önüne geçerler. Na zadávání inzerátů pamatují i pravidla fóra, konkrétně odstavec 2.

Proto prosím, pokud se nejedná o aukci, vždy uvádějte cenu při prodeji. Pokud je to jen trochu možné, tak i vaši představu o ceně v případě inzerátů ke koupi.

2.1 Fórum Inzerce používáme pro poptávky a nabídky související s telekomunikační problematikou.
2.2 Příspěvek je umístěn s primárním štítkem Inzerce a sekundárním štítkem Koupě, Prodej nebo Práce. Sekundární štítek Komerční sdělení používáme pro komerční nabídky. Komerční sdělení nesmějí být obtěžující ani často se opakující.
2.3 Příspěvek je zadáván s důrazem na rychlou orientaci, proto zvolte odpovídající nadpis inzerátu a v textu uvádíme cenu, možnost odpočtu DPH, místo předání, stav zboží, případně důvod prodeje, fotografie a preferovaný kontakt na Vás, nejlépe email nebo telefonní číslo.
2.4 Zadavatel inzerátu je povinnen informovat o ukončení obchodu tím, že doplní do nadpisu příspěvku "Ukončeno -" a/nebo přidělí sekundární štítek Ukončeno.
2.5 Není-li uvedeno jinak, má se za to, že prvním zájemcem je osoba, která se vyjádří ve vlákně inzerátu, nikoliv neveřejnou cestou.
2.6 V případě aukcí je zadavatel povinnen stanovit čas vypršení, přičemž vítězem aukce se stává zájemce s nejvyšší nabídkou podanou v platném čase. Nejmenší rozlišovací časovou jednotkou je jedna minuta.
2.7 Do Událostí lze umístit i pozvánku na jakýkoliv setkání k telekomunikačnímu tématu, včetně setkání komerčního.

Děkuju za fórum i vaši obchodní protistranu.

Matt

After 14 years on XenForo, the site has now moved over to Flarum.

A bit of honesty about the why: the forum has been largely idle for a while, and the XenForo software hadn't been updated in several years. Renewing the licence annually for a site that doesn't generate any revenue stopped making sense, and running ageing forum software comes with its own risks. Flarum is open source, free, modern, and fits the scale of activity we have these days.

Everything is still here:

All 26,500+ threads and ~ 284,000 posts going back to January 2006
Every user account (5,200+ members)
Your private conversations / inbox
Photo galleries, Garage showcase entries, resources, and member blogs
Old XenForo URLs will redirect to their Flarum equivalents, so any links you'd shared elsewhere still work

What's different:

The interface is completely new : Flarum feels snappier and more like a modern forum should in 2026
"Forums" are now "Tags" : categories work much the same way, just labelled differently
Thread prefixes (For Sale, Resolved, Z22SE, etc.) appear as colored chips alongside the discussion title
A handful of niche XenForo add-on features (custom profile fields, some moderation tools) didn't carry over.

What you need to do:

Because XenForo and Flarum store passwords differently, you'll need to reset your password the first time you log in. Head to https://z22se.co.uk/, click Log In → Forgot Password, enter your email, and you'll get a reset link.

Have a click around and let us know what you think. Apologies for the long radio silence on the admin side, the site's now on a footing where it can keep running for the foreseeable, whatever happens with activity levels.

Matt

I still have some manual tidying up to do, considering the differences between XenForo and Flarum, but 99% of the work is done as part of the initial migration.

This forum may discuss any works by the developer of The Last Sovereign, Sierra Lee. However, any other names Sierra Lee may use, and any work published under other names, should not be mentioned.
Reviving old discussions is okay if it's topical. Try to find existing discussions first, to see if your post fits in an existing thread or if your question is already answered. But don't be afraid to start a new thread if needed.
If you make a new thread, title it something descriptive and specific, not something generic and vague like 'question" or "request".
Be civil. Don't flame or harass. If debating, criticize the ideas and not the person behind them. If you feel someone is being offensive, your first response should be to give benefit of the doubt and deescalate, or report them without engaging. Click the "..." menu and then the "Flag" option to report a post for moderator review.
Be patient with newbies and those whose first language is not English.
Post in English. Try to post in clear and correct English, because that is easier for everyone to understand, including fans who don't speak English well. Don't post in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, don't Capitalize The First Letter Of Every Word, and don't go crazy with text formatting.
It's discouraged to post images consisting only of text - just quote the text.

FEATURES
What Kozha does.
Speech input

Record speech in your browser. Transcription uses your device's built-in speech recognition — no audio leaves your machine.

Text-to-Sign

Type a sentence and see it translated into sign language animations. Words not in the dictionary are fingerspelled automatically.

Video Input

Upload a recorded video. Kozha extracts the audio track, transcribes it, and generates the corresponding sign sequence.

STEM Vocabulary

Pre-loaded with scientific abbreviation packs. "Carbon dioxide" becomes "CO₂" before planning — no manual editing needed.

Automatic Planning

Input text is normalized, lemmatized, and mapped to available signs. The planner reorders words to match sign language grammar.

Deaf-governed Contributions

Every new sign is reviewed by two Deaf native signers before it ships. The Deaf advisory board is currently being seated; until it is, community drafts are queued rather than published. Governance →

THE PROCESS
How it works.
01
Provide input

Type text, record speech with your microphone, or upload a video file. All three modes work in the same session.

02
Plan the translation

The planner normalizes your text, applies abbreviations, and looks up each token in the sign database. Unknown words are queued for fingerspelling.

03
Animate the signs

The matched signs are rendered as a 3D avatar animation using SiGML data. Everything runs client-side in your browser.

THE PROJECT LIVES ON CONTRIBUTIONS
Without contributors,
this dictionary stays small.

Most sign-language vocabularies on the web cover only a few hundred everyday words. Kozha can only animate what its dictionary contains — so every sign you add unblocks a translation that would otherwise come back blank. This is how the project grows.

关于咖啡厅的初心…..是想要和大家共同创建一个可以让大家交朋友，一个可以给大家带来温暖的小窝…

诶？你问店长有没有理想？嗯…理想的话….当然是想要在现实中开一家能和大家一起玩耍的咖啡厅啦~~
如果…这个目标实现的话，阳阳要送咖啡厅的大家一人一杯免费的咖啡~ ~ ！ ˃̶͈ ꇴ ˂̶͈

关于咖啡厅的初心…..是想要和大家共同创建一个可以让大家交朋友，一个可以给大家带来温暖的小窝…

当然！ 想要实现这些的前提，是想要和大家一起努力呢，毕竟…咖啡厅是属于大家的哦，咖啡厅的环境也是由大家决定的……所以，尽情的发表自己的意见吧！！！不管是很棒的意见，很不好的意见，尽情的在这里发表吧！！

诶？你问店长有没有理想？嗯…理想的话….当然是想要在现实中开一家能和大家一起玩耍的咖啡厅啦~~
如果…这个目标实现的话，阳阳要送咖啡厅的大家一人一杯免费的咖啡~ ~ ！ ˃̶͈ ꇴ ˂̶͈

A.title: BOOJUM BREWING CO
A.text:
BOOJUM BREWING
WAYNESVILLE, NC
Located in the shadow of the Smoky Mountains, our Downtown Waynesville taproom has a relaxed atmosphere where you can enjoy lunch, dinner or drinks.  

Enjoy seasonal pub faire including tasty burgers, sandwiches, seafood & steak. Our taproom features 16 taps of fresh, delicious & ever rotating Boojum Beer plus wine & craft cocktails. Come cozy up inside or take in the mountain air on our back deck. At night, check out our 21+ speakeasy-style Gem Bar, located just below the restaurant. 

WHAT'S THE WAIT RIGHT NOW?
PHONE

Restaurant - (828) 246-0350

Brewery - (828) 944-0888 

LOCATION

50 N Main St.
Waynesville, Nc 28786

 

HOURS

M, W-Sun 11.30am–9pm

Tues Closed           

                         
CURRENT LINEUP

HOP FIEND IPA  Hops, hops, hops. Nothing else matters to a hop fiend. They gather them up, admire them, hoard them, love them, devour them - always thirsting for more.
A West Coast IPA generously hopped with Mosaic, Simcoe & Citra, Hop Fiend is the perfect blend of tropical fruit, citrus & pine.
See hops. Want hops. Drink hops. 6.5%

REWARD PALE ALE  Crisp, hop forward & dangerously drinkable. This dry-hopped pale ale opens with a citrusy aroma and finishes nice & clean. 5.6%

HOUNDS OF HELLES LAGER  You’ve sniffed out our light & refreshing Munich-style Helles. This golden lager is prized for its soft, bready malt character, easy drinkability & crisp finish. It’s just what you’ve been looking for. 5% ABV

BLUE RIDGE HAZE IPA  Rolling in fresh, juicy & tropical, this hazy IPA is packed with the finest blend of El Dorado, Equinox, Huell Melon, Mosaic & Idaho 7 hops. Enter a cloud of pine & citrus & immerse yourself in flavors of mango, pineapple, strawberry & papaya 6.2% ABV

KING OF THE MOUNTAIN DIPA  From the highest cave in the range, the Boojum watches over his domain. Others fall in line behind the biggest beast, the most dangerous creature. In his honor, we created a beast of a beer, able to stand up to all others. Double the hops. Double the malt. We didn’t hold back on the beer destined to be king. 8%

CHUPACABRA MEXICAN LAGER  Crisp, clean & refreshing with mild malt & noble hop flavors. German malts & flaked corn provide a light body for this smooth lager. 4.5% ABV

NEW YEAR ROUND RELEASE

Light, smooth & citrusy, this White Ale is crafted with white wheat, CuraCao oranges & freshly ground coriander. Subtle spice notes & bright citrus create a unique & refreshing flavor, while wheat & oats provide a soft feel & crisp finish. So hurry up, take a sip & follow the White Rabbit on a curiously tasty trip. 5% ABV 

AVAILABLE ON DRAFT & IN CANS NOW.

ROTATING RELEASES

SPECIAL RELEASE SERIES

Lush & green summertime IPA with strawberry, melon, citrus & passionfruit hop flavors.  6% ABV  MARCH - JULY

HAZY IPA SERIES

GET OFF MY CLOUD NE IPA  Juicy, hazy New England IPA brewed with heaps of El Dorado, Huell Melon, Mosaic, Citra, Equinox & more hops.  6.5% ABV  

The Gem Bar 

Located right below our t

A.title: Instrução Normativa PRES/INSS nº 213
A.text:
Instrução Normativa PRES/INSS nº 213, de 17.08.2026
- DOU de 19.08.2026 -

Altera a Instrução Normativa PRES/INSS nº 138, de 10 de novembro 2022, que estabelece critérios e procedimentos operacionais relativos à consignação de descontos para pagamento de crédito consignado contraído nos benefícios pagos pelo INSS.

A PRESIDENTE DO INSTITUTO NACIONAL DO SEGURO SOCIAL - INSS, no uso das atribuições que lhe confere o Decreto nº 10.995, de 14 de março de 2022, e tendo em vista o que consta no Processo Administrativo nº 35014.065975/2022-22, resolve:

Art. 1ºA Instrução Normativa PRES/INSS nº 138, de 10 de novembro de 2022, republicada no Diário Oficial da União de 13 de dezembro de 2022, passa a vigorar com as seguintes alterações:

"Art. 5º.............................................................................

.........................................................................................

§ 20. A autorização de que trata o inciso IX, do caput, se dará via termo de autorização de portabilidade para as operações de portabilidade, devendo a instituição consignatária proponente confirmar a operação em até vinte dias contados da autorização do titular do benefício, sob pena de cancelamento da operação.

§ 21. A autorização da operação no aplicativo Meu INSS será oportunizada mediante login gov.br e utilização dos dados da conta bancária quando não existir a biometria nas bases governamentais para fins de validação da imagem de que trata o inciso IX, do caput." (NR)

"Art. 8º.............................................................................

.........................................................................................

§ 1º Os benefícios referidos no art. 1º, concedidos a partir de 1º de abril de 2019, permanecerão bloqueados para a realização de crédito consignado por noventa dias, contados da Data de Despacho do Benefício - DDB, ou seja, da data de concessão do benefício.

........................................................................................." (NR)

"Art. 23-A. Os descontos e respectivos repasses serão interrompidos em razão do não envio de documentos ou informações exigidas nesta Instrução Normativa pelas instituições consignatárias." (NR)

"Art. 34...............................................................................

...........................................................................................

VI - ......................................................................................

............................................................................................

f) dados estruturados referentes ao depósito dos valores correspondentes às operações de crédito consignado em até sete dias úteis da contratação;

..........................................................................................." (NR)

"Art. 36.............................................................................

................................................................

A.title: Summer Dance Classes in Babylon | Positions Dance Studio — Positions Dance Studio
A.text:
Fall registration is open! View the schedule and register HERE.

POSITIONS DANCE STUDIO
Summer Class Schedule

At Positions Dance Studio, we offer a wide range of dance styles including ballet, tap, jazz, acrobatics, hip hop, lyrical, and contemporary to dancers in the Babylon, NY area. Our dance classes start with Dance with Me (starting at 3 months!) and continue for dancers ages 2- adult!

Looking for something fun to do this summer? Take a dance class! Summer is the perfect time to try something new or master your technique.  Summer registration is OPEN! 

The goal of all of our programs is to make dance accessible to ALL while maintaining a strong focus on technique. Review the schedule below and save your child’s spot.   

We can’t wait to welcome your family to Positions Dance Studio!

REGISTER TODAY
2026 Summer Class Schedule
July 11 - August 13

Summer classes start July 11.  5-Week summer tuition starts at $120. After registering, you will be sent an invoice for your summer payment. Payment must be received within 14 days of enrollment to hold your space. If this is your first time taking a class with Positions Dance Studio, you will be prompted to create an account. Click any of the “register” buttons to begin! Filter the schedule by age OR class day to find the perfect class for your child.


 
 
 
Subscribe to Our Mailing List!

Sign up with your email address to receive news and updates from Positions Dance Studio! 

SIGN UP

We respect your privacy.

A.title: Journey Desktop 2024: Sneak Peek of New Desktop App for Windows, Mac & Linux - Journey Forum
A.text:
DesktopAnnouncement
Journey Desktop 2024: Sneak Peek of New Desktop App for Windows, Mac & Linux
1 of 44 posts 
admin
Jul 14, 2024

Dear Journey patron,

We heard you. We understand you need a better desktop app for Journey, and we are excited to share our plans for its future.

The current Windows, Mac Classic, and Linux apps are in maintenance mode due to outdated technology that makes it unsustainable to continue their development. These older versions also lack important features that many of you have requested, such as Apple sign-in and Journey Cloud Sync. To address these limitations and provide a more seamless, modern experience, we are introducing a new desktop app: "Journey Desktop 2024." This new app will replace the existing Windows, Mac Classic, and Linux apps to offer improved functionality and a better overall user experience.

What to Expect:

Journey Desktop 2024 is designed to meet the evolving needs of our users and will come with a host of exciting new features:

A new colored theme UI
Journey Cloud Sync
Email and Apple login
End-to-End Encryption (E2EE)
Shared web links and journals
Print to PDF
Export to DOCX and EPUB formats
Odyssey AI
Smart photo organization
Elastic search
Support self-host

We are committed to delivering a superior journaling experience with Journey Desktop 2024. We plan to release the alpha version by early August 2024, and we can't wait for you to try it out and share your feedback.

Thank you for your continued support and trust in Journey.

Warm regards,
The Journey Team

A.title: C++ Real-Time Audio Programming with Bela: a free online course - Bela
A.text:
Online C++ course
C++ Real-Time Audio Programming with Bela: a free online course
1 of 14 posts 
giuliomoro
Apr 29, 2020Edited

We are excited to announce that we just released a course on C++ Real-Time Audio Programming with Bela. This is aimed at beginner to intermediate C++ users, so if you have so far been using Bela with other languages and you are interested in tipping you toes in C++, this is a great occasion. If you know your C++ stuff, you may still want to check out some of the more advanced topics (ARM/NEON assembly, state machines, fixed-point maths, timing, block-based processing).

During the course you will learn:

Writing real-time audio code in C++
Running that code on embedded hardware
Creating musical instruments, audio effects and synth modules
Turning digital signal processing theory into working code

New lessons will be coming out twice a week for a few months, covering programming topics such as:

Working in real time, Buffers and arrays, Parameter control, Classes and objects, Analog and digital I/O, Filtering, Circular buffers, Timing in real time, State machines, MIDI, Block-based processing, Threads, Fixed point arithmetic, ARM assembly language

all of this while building audio signal processors that implement:

Oscillators, Samples, Wavetables, Filters, Control voltages, Gates and triggers, Delays and delay-based effects, Metronomes and clocks, Envelopes, ADSR, MIDI, Additive synthesis, Phase vocoders, Impulse reverb

Subscribe to our youtube channel so that you don't miss any of the upcoming classes, and feel free to share this with your friends on Twitter, Facebook and Instagram.

Af a "getting started" lesson 0 last week, the course has fully started today with lesson 1, and the next class will be out this Friday at 5pm.

Note: you will need up-to-date Bela code to follow along with the course, as the example code relies on some of the latest features we added (namely the slider Gui via the GuiController library). Updating your board is covered in lesson 0.

As you'd expect, you can find support here on the forum, using the "Online C++ course" tag.

A.title: Mănăstirea “Sfânta Treime” (Saharna) - Resurse Educaționale
A.text:
Recreere / Excursii
Mănăstirea “Sfânta Treime” (Saharna)
1 din 16 postări 
luna
13 mai 2021Modificat

Mănăstirea Saharna, în întregul ei ansamblu, este unul din cele mai vechi aşezăminte monahale din cuprinsul Bisericii Ortodoxe din Republica Moldova. Ansamblul monastic este compus din două mănăstiri: una rupestră (Bunavestire) şi alta terestră (Sf. Treime).

Istoria mănăstirii rupestre se cunoaşte foarte puţin, neştiindu-se data precisă a întemeierii şi cine sunt întemeietorii. Nici chiar cercetătorii din domeniu n-au ajuns încă la o părere unanimă privind perioada întemeierii acestei chinovii. Ea rămâne blândă şi tăcută în aşteptarea unor timpuri mai bune, când istoria ei zbuciumată, dar şi glorioasă, va fi cunoscută şi elogiată de toată lumea creştină.

Mănăstirea terestră, fiind o ctitorie călugărească, a fost întemeiată în anul 1776 de către Schimonahul Vartolomeu Ciungu (anii de viaţă – 1739-1798, Ciungu nu este numele de familie, ci doar un apelativ). Câte ceva despre viaţa stareţului Vartolomeu aflăm din inscripţia, ce însoţea portretul lui, descoperit în trapeza mănăstirii „Sf. Treime” Rudi de către inginerul-arhitect Nicolae Ţiganco, portret, ce mai târziu dispare fără urmă. Iată această inscripţie, tradusă din limba ucraineană în română în anul 1928: „… în 1739 în ziua 23 a lunii decembrie a avut loc naşterea trupească, /a/ numitu/lui/ Vasile, /din/părintele preot Teodor şi maică Pelagheia. În anul 1760 în ziua de 2 a lunii mai în oraşul Savran gubernia Podoliei, fiind logodit şi mergând la logodnica sa pentru a se căsători, Vasile fusese pe neaşteptate rănit cu un glonţ în mâna stângă, iar la an 1766 … a lunii mai a părăsit patria sa şi a venit în Moldova. An 1776 în luna martie ziua 25 a intrat în Saharna. Nu era nimic, era acolo un loc pustiu, a clădit biserica, chilii, ogradă şi altele”.

Există unele momente, care ne permit să presupunem că până a începe construcţia noii mănăstiri, Vartolomeu cu o mică comunitate de călugări trăiseră în mănăstirea din stâncă. Însă viaţa în acel loc era foarte anevoioasă şi părintele Vartolomeu hotărăşte construcţia unei mănăstiri terestre, care ar fi fost şi aproape de căile de comunicare din localităţile apropiate, şi aşezată într-un loc unde liniştea călugărilor nu avea să fie tulburată prea mult de forfota lumească. Era destul de dificil să găseşti un asemenea loc şi după cum spune tradiţia că se cuvenea unui bun călugăr şi creştin, înainte de începerea lucrărilor, Vartolomeu trăieşte 40 de zile de post şi rugăciune, pentru a milostivi pe Dumnezeu şi sfinţii, ca să fie ajutat în alegerea cât mai reuşită a unui loc pentru construcţia mănăstirii. Legenda spune, că la a 40-ea zi de rugăciune, el a avut o revelaţie. I s-a arătat Preasfânta Fecioară Maria, Născătoarea de Dumnezeu, care era înconjurată de foc ceresc şi i-a arătat locul, unde, după voia Celui Preaînalt, trebuia să construiască locaşul monahal închinat Sfintei Treimi. A.text:
Genel Kenevir YetiştirmeYetiştirme Sorunları
Esrar Yetiştirirken Karşılaşılan Hastalıklar,Sorunlar ve Çözümleri
1 / 75 gönderi 
tohumsuzCOM
25 Şub 2020Düzenlendi
Bor Eksikliği:

Problem: Cannabis yaprakları ve köklerinde anormallik büyümede yavaşlama. Bor Eksikliğinin ilk belirtilerinden biri anormal veya kalınlaşmış yaprak uçlarıdır.. Yeni yapraklarda sarılaşma görülebilir. Dal gövdeleri kaba ama koflaşabilir. Çiçek sanki Kalsiyum eksikliği çekiyormuş gibi görünebilir. Çünkü, bitkinin Kalsiyumu etkin kullanabilmesi için Bora ihtiyaç duyulur. Yeni büyüyen bitkiler en çok ekilenenlerdir. Bitkiniz sanki yanmış veya alazlanmış gibi görünebilir . Eğer toprataki Ph değeri çok yüksekse (kullandığınız su veya fazla gübrelemeden dolayı yükseltmiş olabilirsiniz) de Bor Eksikliği belirtilerini gösterebilir çiçeğiniz. Bakınız aşağıdaki resim örnekleri;



Çözüm: Temiz, kaliteli su, ile bitkinizi flushlayın (yıkayın toprağını) Ph değeri ayarlı (ya da olması gereken normal değerde kaliteli) suya normal dozun yarısı kadar besin katın ve çiçeğinizin yeni gelişen dal ve yapraklarının sağlığını gözlemleyin.

Kalsiyum Eksikliği:

Problem: Kalsiyum eksikliğini farketmek nispeten zor bir iştir. Zira sıklıkla, magnezyum, demir ve diğer eksikliklerin semptomları ile karıştırılabiliyor. Yinede, kalsiyum eksikliğinin bazı genel belirtileri şunlardır: Yapraklarda ölü bölgeler noktalar oluşur, ufak kahverengi noktalar, bölgeler gibi. Diğer önemli bir belirtiside, yeni gelen yaprakların ufak olması ve uclarının biçimsizleşmesi kıvrılmasıdır. Bitkinin içinde veya çiçeklerde/sömeklerde zayıflama görülebilir. Köklerde bakteri izleri, ölü veya yetersiz gelişme görülebilir.Detaylı fikir edinmek için bakınız aşağıdaki resimler:


Çözüm: Eğer çiçeğinizin kök bölgesindeki pH bozuksa, kötü ise bu demektir ki, cannabisiniz kalsiyumu uygun şekilde abzorbe edemiyordur. İlk adım, yetişme bölgesindeki doğru pH değerlerine sahip olduğunuzdan emin olun. Her cannabis çeşidi kendine özgü besin problemlerine sahiptir. Ancak, kalsiyum, magnezyum ve demir problemleri çoğunlukla aynı zamanda ortaya çıkar cannabiste.
Pro yetiştiriciler, gübre tedarik ederken ayrıca CaMg (Kalsiyum Magnezyum) sağlayan tamamlayıcı besinide verirler. Bu sayede bu tarz eksikliklerin önüne geçerler. Eğer şimdiye kadar elinizde böyle bir tamamlayıcı yoksa, hemen tedarik ederek bitkinize verdiğinizde bir hafta içerisinde sağlıklı büyümeyi gözlemlersiniz.

Problem: Cannabiste bakır eksikliği, yaprakların geriye doğru kıvrılması, büyüme eksikliği ve yapraklarda anormal renk değişikliği şeklinde tezahür eder. Diğer yapraklarda sarı veya beyazlama işaretleri belirirken, yeni gelen yapraklar koyu ve dönmüş olarak gelişebilir.Toprağınızda veya suyunuzda bakır bulunması pek olası değil. A.title: Pravidla zadávání inzerátů, zejména pravidlo uvádění ceny - Telekomunikace.cz
A.text:
Inzerce
Pravidla zadávání inzerátů, zejména pravidlo uvádění ceny
1 of 2 posts 
zdenda
12. lis 2025Upraveno

Na zadávání inzerátů pamatují i pravidla fóra, konkrétně odstavec 2.

Proto prosím, pokud se nejedná o aukci, vždy uvádějte cenu při prodeji. Pokud je to jen trochu možné, tak i vaši představu o ceně v případě inzerátů ke koupi.

2.1 Fórum Inzerce používáme pro poptávky a nabídky související s telekomunikační problematikou.
2.2 Příspěvek je umístěn s primárním štítkem Inzerce a sekundárním štítkem Koupě, Prodej nebo Práce. Sekundární štítek Komerční sdělení používáme pro komerční nabídky. Komerční sdělení nesmějí být obtěžující ani často se opakující.
2.3 Příspěvek je zadáván s důrazem na rychlou orientaci, proto zvolte odpovídající nadpis inzerátu a v textu uvádíme cenu, možnost odpočtu DPH, místo předání, stav zboží, případně důvod prodeje, fotografie a preferovaný kontakt na Vás, nejlépe email nebo telefonní číslo.
2.4 Zadavatel inzerátu je povinnen informovat o ukončení obchodu tím, že doplní do nadpisu příspěvku "Ukončeno -" a/nebo přidělí sekundární štítek Ukončeno.
2.5 Není-li uvedeno jinak, má se za to, že prvním zájemcem je osoba, která se vyjádří ve vlákně inzerátu, nikoliv neveřejnou cestou.
2.6 V případě aukcí je zadavatel povinnen stanovit čas vypršení, přičemž vítězem aukce se stává zájemce s nejvyšší nabídkou podanou v platném čase. Nejmenší rozlišovací časovou jednotkou je jedna minuta.
2.7 Do Událostí lze umístit i pozvánku na jakýkoliv setkání k telekomunikačnímu tématu, včetně setkání komerčního.

Děkuju za fórum i vaši obchodní protistranu.

A.title: Forum migration: XenForo → Flarum - Z22SE Forum
A.text:
Z22SE Site News
Forum migration: XenForo → Flarum
1 of 3 posts 
Matt
17 MayEdited

After 14 years on XenForo, the site has now moved over to Flarum.

A bit of honesty about the why: the forum has been largely idle for a while, and the XenForo software hadn't been updated in several years. Renewing the licence annually for a site that doesn't generate any revenue stopped making sense, and running ageing forum software comes with its own risks. Flarum is open source, free, modern, and fits the scale of activity we have these days.

Everything is still here:

All 26,500+ threads and ~ 284,000 posts going back to January 2006
Every user account (5,200+ members)
Your private conversations / inbox
Photo galleries, Garage showcase entries, resources, and member blogs
Old XenForo URLs will redirect to their Flarum equivalents, so any links you'd shared elsewhere still work

What's different:

The interface is completely new : Flarum feels snappier and more like a modern forum should in 2026
"Forums" are now "Tags" : categories work much the same way, just labelled differently
Thread prefixes (For Sale, Resolved, Z22SE, etc.) appear as colored chips alongside the discussion title
A handful of niche XenForo add-on features (custom profile fields, some moderation tools) didn't carry over.

What you need to do:

Because XenForo and Flarum store passwords differently, you'll need to reset your password the first time you log in. Head to https://z22se.co.uk/, click Log In → Forgot Password, enter your email, and you'll get a reset link.

Have a click around and let us know what you think. Apologies for the long radio silence on the admin side, the site's now on a footing where it can keep running for the foreseeable, whatever happens with activity levels.

Matt

Reply
Matt
17 May

I still have some manual tidying up to do, considering the differences between XenForo and Flarum, but 99% of the work is done as part of the initial migration.

B.title: Forum migration: XenForo → Flarum - Z22SE Forum
B.text:
Forum migration: XenForo → Flarum
1 of 3 posts 
Matt
17 MayEdited

After 14 years on XenForo, the site has now moved over to Flarum.

A bit of honesty about the why: the forum has been largely idle for a while, and the XenForo software hadn't been updated in several years. Renewing the licence annually for a site that doesn't generate any revenue stopped making sense, and running ageing forum software comes with its own risks. Flarum is open source, free, modern, and fits the scale of activity we have these days.

Everything is still here:

All 26,500+ threads and ~ 284,000 posts going back to January 2006
Every user account (5,200+ members)
Your private conversations / inbox
Photo galleries, Garage showcase entries, resources, and member blogs
Old XenForo URLs will redirect to their Flarum equivalents, so any links you'd shared elsewhere still work

What's different:

The interface is completely new : Flarum feels snappier and more like a modern forum should in 2026
"Forums" are now "Tags" : categories work much the same way, just labelled differently
Thread prefixes (For Sale, Resolved, Z22SE, etc.) appear as colored chips alongside the discussion title
A handful of niche XenForo add-on features (custom profile fields, some moderation tools) didn't carry over.

What you need to do:

Because XenForo and Flarum store passwords differently, you'll need to reset your password the first time you log in. Head to https://z22se.co.uk/, click Log In → Forgot Password, enter your email, and you'll get a reset link.

Have a click around and let us know what you think. Apologies for the long radio silence on the admin side, the site's now on a footing where it can keep running for the foreseeable, whatever happens with activity levels.

Matt

Matt
17 May

I still have some manual tidying up to do, considering the differences between XenForo and Flarum, but 99% of the work is done as part of the initial migration.

A.title: Nu te koop: Pretpark.club CoasterTracker-pin! - Pretpark.club forum
A.text:
We serveren mogelijk externe cookies door embeds in forumtopics. Meer informatie
Oké!
MENU
Pretpark TalkNieuwsberichten
Nu te koop: Pretpark.club CoasterTracker-pin!
1 van 30 berichten 
John
6 nov. 2025Bijgewerkt

Onze CoasterTracker is een tijdje online en het afgelopen jaar hebben we veel liefde gegeven aan de content. Om te vieren dat er inmiddels 50.000 achtbaanritjes ingevoerd zijn(!) hebben we iets leuks voor jullie: De Pretpark.club CoasterTracker-pin!

De pin is in een beperkte oplage beschikbaar en uitgevoerd in goud emaille waarbij het logo van de tracker prachtig tot zijn recht komt.

Die wil ik! Wat kost dat?

Voor €10,- inclusief verzendkosten* sturen we de pin naar je op!
Omdat we binnenkort ook 2 meet-ups hebben (komende zaterdag in Bommelwereld en 3 januari 2026 in Slagharen (details volgen)), kun je de pin ook daar krijgen. Dit scheelt ons verzenden waardoor de prijs bij afhalen op een van deze meetings €8,50 zal zijn.
Lees wel even verder, want we willen wel graag weten dat jij er eentje wil hebben.

(*) Prijs inclusief verzendkosten is voor Nederland. De meerprijs voor België is €0,75. Daarmee komt de prijs op €10,75 euro. Andere landen zijn ook mogelijk maar op verzoek beschikbaar. Stuur dan een e-mail naar team@pretpark.club

Hoe bestel ik de pin?

Via het bestelformulier onder deze reactie kun je de pin bestellen. Zodra je alle gegevens hebt ingevuld en het formulier verstuurd hebt, pakken wij de administratie op en sturen we een e-mail naar het opgegeven e-mailadres. In de mail zit een betaalinstructie en betaallink waardoor je makkelijk en snel de betaling kunt regelen.

Hoe ontvang ik de pin?

Kies je voor afhalen bij een meet-up? Dan krijg je hem uiteraard ter plekke samen met je badge op de meeting.
Kies je voor thuisbezorgen dan sturen we de pin naar je op zodra we de betaling hebben ontvangen. We zullen hem inpakken in een stevige envelop en sturen hem naar je op. PostNL zal er alles aan doen om de pin zo snel mogelijk bij je te bezorgen.

Wat gebeurt er met mijn gegevens?

Maximaal acht weken nadat we de pin verstuurd hebben en zonder wederhoor, zullen wij de gegevens die niet langer noodzakelijk zijn weer verwijderen uit onze administratie.

Op = op

We hebben eenmalige badge van 100 pins laten maken. Op = op.
Omdat we zoveel mogelijk clubleden willen bedienen houden we het voorlopig op een limiet van 1 pin per forumgebruiker. Mocht je samenwonen met iemand anders, laat dat ons dan even weten via het bestelformulier en vul dan meerdere forumnamen in. Omdat het gewicht van 2 pins de 20 gram mogelijk overstijgt kost het helaas wel 2x verzendkosten.

Reageren
ASF, BjornB, LoopingStar, en 2 anderen vinden dit leuk.
John
6 nov. 2025Bijgewerkt

Log in of registreer jezelf om alle content te bekijken.

Werkt het formulier niet? Refresh de pagina dan even!

Ben je geen lid op ons forum en kun je daarom de link niet zien? Klik dan hier voor het formulier en vul - in bij je forumnaam

Reageren
Mark vindt dit leuk.
Michael
